SELECT T.TEST_ID AS testId, T.SYS_ID AS sysId, S.SYS_NM AS sysNm, T.TITLE AS title, T.TEST_TYPE AS testType, TC.CODE_NM AS testTypeNm, T.TEST_ENV AS testEnv, EC.CODE_NM AS testEnvNm, T.STATUS AS status, SC.CODE_NM AS statusNm, TO_CHAR(T.PLAN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS planDt FROM OPS_TEST T LEFT JOIN OPS_SYSTEM S ON T.SYS_ID = S.SYS_ID LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE TC ON TC.CODE_GRP = 'TEST_TYPE' AND TC.CODE_ID = T.TEST_TYPE LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE EC ON EC.CODE_GRP = 'TEST_ENV' AND EC.CODE_ID = T.TEST_ENV LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE SC ON SC.CODE_GRP = 'TEST_STATUS' AND SC.CODE_ID = T.STATUS WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY T.TEST_ID DESC OFFSET #{firstIndex} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{recordCountPerPage} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM OPS_TEST T WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT T.TEST_ID AS testId, T.SYS_ID AS sysId, S.SYS_NM AS sysNm, T.CHG_ID AS chgId, T.TITLE AS title, T.TEST_TYPE AS testType, TC.CODE_NM AS testTypeNm, T.TEST_ENV AS testEnv, EC.CODE_NM AS testEnvNm, T.STATUS AS status, SC.CODE_NM AS statusNm, TO_CHAR(T.PLAN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS planDt, T.TESTER_ID AS testerId, T.RESULT_SUMMARY AS resultSummary, TO_CHAR(T.REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS regDt FROM OPS_TEST T LEFT JOIN OPS_SYSTEM S ON T.SYS_ID = S.SYS_ID LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE TC ON TC.CODE_GRP = 'TEST_TYPE' AND TC.CODE_ID = T.TEST_TYPE LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE EC ON EC.CODE_GRP = 'TEST_ENV' AND EC.CODE_ID = T.TEST_ENV LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE SC ON SC.CODE_GRP = 'TEST_STATUS' AND SC.CODE_ID = T.STATUS WHERE T.TEST_ID = #{testId}

SELECT CA.CASE_ID AS caseId, CA.TEST_ID AS testId, CA.CASE_NM AS caseNm, CA.EXPECTED AS expected, CA.CASE_RESULT AS caseResult, RC.CODE_NM AS caseResultNm, CA.REMARK AS remark FROM OPS_TEST_CASE CA LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE RC ON RC.CODE_GRP = 'TEST_CASE_RESULT' AND RC.CODE_ID = CA.CASE_RESULT WHERE CA.TEST_ID = #{testId} ORDER BY CA.CASE_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO OPS_TEST (SYS_ID, CHG_ID, TITLE, TEST_TYPE, TEST_ENV, STATUS, PLAN_DT, TESTER_ID, RESULT_SUMMARY, REG_DT) VALUES (#{sysId}, #{chgId}, #{title}, #{testType}, #{testEnv}, #{status}, TO_DATE(#{planDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')NULL, #{testerId}, #{resultSummary}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
INSERT INTO OPS_TEST_CASE (TEST_ID, CASE_NM, EXPECTED, CASE_RESULT, REMARK) VALUES (#{testId}, #{caseNm}, #{expected}, #{caseResult}, #{remark})
